messages:
Maya: FYI support flagged a case where quota consumption stayed on old project after an SA move. looks like requests were still attributed to proj-old for ~8m.
Arjun: thanks. do we think this is a routing key issue or something higher (billing pipeline)?
Maya: traced to auth-proxy cache. we use a composite key that includes X-Origin-Project header. that header occasionally lags during our token-exchange flow.
Liam: think we made the header the source-of-truth to avoid extra introspect calls, but that creates window-of-inconsistency on exchange.
Casey: quick question—how often do we refresh cache entries? current TTL is 5m right?
Maya: yes 5m. customer tokens were short-lived; exchange happened but proxy kept serving from cache.
Arjun: short-term mitigation: drop header from cache key entirely, prefer token-introspect project claim when present. fallback to header only if introspect fails. reduce TTL for keys with ephemeral tokens to 30s.
Liam: telemetry change request: emit auth.proxy.attribution_changed events when resolved project != cached project, include sampled request_id and prev_project/new_project. that'll help support + billing recon.
Casey: UX: console should map a brief "attribution drift" marker on quota time-series with a link to sample request IDs and the timestamp range. no noisy alerts but visible for operators.
Arjun: plan: 1) patch proxy to prefer introspect and set ephemeral TTL flag 2) roll to canary (5%) in us-east1 3) watch attribution_changed and quota-usage-per-project for anomalies 4) then update console annotation.
Maya: one caveat: introspect adds ~10ms median. we should run perf benchmark and consider async refresh if tail latency spikes.
Liam: agree. also add a debug sampling mode that logs full header/introspect pairs for 0.1% of traffic for 24h.
Casey: support playbook note: when customers report sudden quota allocation issues after SA moves, check metric project_attribution_diff and run "auth-lookup <token>" to see resolved project and exchange logs.
Maya: opening PR for cache-key change and a short TTL flag. will include perf numbers. tagging @deploy-bot to schedule canary after merge.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy/patch-178 -> canary 5% us-east1. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4987 :rocket:
Arjun: thanks all. follow-up in #incidents if anything unexpected shows up overnight.
